test_cases.name: Default single nickname with a fixed seed
Batch of five de-duplicated nicknames as JSON
test_cases.expected: JSON with nicknames array of length 5, all names distinct, seed=42

test_cases.name: Style and length filters
test_cases.command: python3 scripts/generate_nickname.py --seed 9 --count 3 --style 文艺 --length long --format json
test_cases.expected: JSON with style=文艺, length=long; every nickname 7-10 chars and every part carries 文艺; fallbacks empty

test_cases.name: Reproducible output for the same seed
test_cases.expected: Identical JSON object for repeated runs with the same seed

test_cases.name: Count upper bound enforced
test_cases.expected: exit 2 and an error stating --count must be <= 20

notes: Pure local Python 3 skill: no Huawei Cloud credentials, CLI, SDK, or network access. All cases are read-only and only read the built-in morpheme pool. When the smoke harness cannot execute interpreter commands, the structural self-check plus the unit tests under tests/ cover the behaviour.
